note: Born 23 Feb 1634 Shangqiu. WD Q10947777 P569.
Kangxi 38 southern tour (Yingluan riji 1): 齒好麽？眼好麽？奏云：俱好。登下看文書，要用眼鏡. ONSET first-person need of spectacles for reading documents.
Kangxi 42 Yingluan erji: 昨曾求眼鏡…即以所現佩者賜爾. Continuity living gift of Kangxi's own worn glass pair — not a new onset.
Died 16 Sept 1713. Survival bound only — do not use as labor tip.
